{{Quote|This is General Callan Grayne, Republic High Command. I've just arrived in orbit above Hoth. Quite a mess down there.|General Grayne|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
'''Callan Grayne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and later became a [[General/Legends|general]] in [[Republic Strategic High Command]] during the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As the [[Galactic War]] broke out with the Empire at the end of the Cold War, Grayne was sent to the [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to take charge of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] offensive there. While coordinating the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on the planet, Grayne enlisted the aid of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]]. General Grayne later assigned [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the order of fellow High Command member [[Durant]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We had some short-lived adventures, back during the war.''"<br />"''You can hardly tell that left leg isn't real, sir. The medtechs did good work.|Grayne and Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="The Price of Victory" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Callan Grayne joined the [[Republic Army]]<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> sometime after [[3665 BBY]]<ref name="date">The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' indicates that [[Elin Garza]] forged her identity credentials at the age of fifteen to enlist in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], meaning that the minimum age must be greater than fifteen. The same guide also gives [[Fideltin Rusk]]'s birth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as [[3680 BBY]], meaning that Rusk had to enlist sometime after [[3665 BBY]]. As Grayne and Rusk both started in the same [[Fideltin Rusk's first squad|squad]], Grayne joined the Military around the same [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> and was placed in a [[Fideltin Rusk's first squad|squad]] that included the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]. The two served together for some [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], fighting in engagements such as the [[Geonosis campaign]], in which they worked alongside a Human named [[Durant]]. During Grayne's time with the [[Squad/Legends|squad]], he was injured in battle and lost his entire left [[Limb/Legends|leg]], though [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] fitted him with a convincingly lifelike [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]].<ref name="The Price of Victory" />

The war ended in [[3653 BBY]] with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> and during the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] Grayne became a [[General/Legends|general]] in [[Republic Strategic High Command]], the highest level of command within the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> Grayne was dispatched to take control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] military forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which was becoming the site of a [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|three-way battle]] between the Republic, the Empire, and the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. All three factions were [[Ground warfare/Legends|fighting]] for control of the ruined [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and prototype technology that had been scattered across the planet's surface since the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior in 3665 BBY.<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> Arriving in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Grayne was alerted to the presence of several Imperial weapons platforms on the edge of [[Crescent Canyon]], which was located only a short distance away from the Republic's [[Aurek Base]] on the west edge of the [[Icetromper Wastes]]. Learning that two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Leeha Narezz]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], had commandeered the [[301st Infantry]] for a [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|covert mission]], Grayne contacted the Hero. As General [[Var Suthra]] had spoken highly of the Knight's military prowess, Grayne requested that the Jedi help the Military in return by destroying the emplacements and eliminating the threat they posed.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

[[File:Rusk_Squad.png|thumb|left|250px|Sergeant Rusk and his squad]]
A short time later, Grayne learned that Rusk, now a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the 301st, was about to attack a White Maw base in the [[Glacial Fissure]] region as part of the Jedi mission, and he ordered [[Fideltin Rusk's squad|Rusk's squad]] to destroy several nearby munition dumps and thereby weaken the White Maw.<ref name="Position of Power" /> After the Jedi completed the mission, Grayne spoke with fellow High Command General Durant, and the two decided to rotate the 301st Infantry back to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and send the [[88th Armor]] in its place. However, Durant also decided to indefinitely assign Rusk to the Hero in order to aid the young Knight, and Grayne requested a meeting with Rusk's squad and the Jedi at Aurek Base. The general relayed Durant's orders to Rusk after a brief reminiscence of their time serving together. Grayne then returned to overseeing the battle against the Empire on Hoth.<ref name="The Price of Victory" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm told you commandeered some men from the 301st Infantry for your classified operation. The Imperial offensive left us in bad shape. We've been scratching your back. Now we need a favor.|General Grayne, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
Callan Grayne had dark skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> A capable [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and [[Commanding officer/Legends|military leader]], Grayne was determined to use every resource available to him and was perfectly willing to compromise with the Jedi, as long as he received military aid in return.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

==Equipment==
As a result of his service during the Great Galactic War, Grayne sported a prosthetic left leg. On Hoth he wore gray, white, and maroon combat [[Clothing/Legends|attire]] suited to the cold weather.<ref name="The Price of Victory" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|General Grayne believes the pirates are reinforcing. He ordered me to hit those munitions dumps. Thought you might want to join in.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="Position of Power" />}}
Callan Grayne appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], in which he is a recurring character in the Hoth storyline for the Jedi Knight class. Grayne contacts the player in the mission "Suicide Squads" and requests aid for destroying nearby weapons emplacements,<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> and Sergeant Rusk contacts the player in the mission "Position of Power" with an additional objective of targeting munitions dumps.<ref name="Position of Power" /> Grayne finally appears in person at the end of "The Price of Victory," in which he assigns Rusk to the Knight and thereby grants the player his or her fourth companion character.<ref name="The Price of Victory" />
